t: 奥斯特罗哥特人之王西奥多里克在伊森佐战役中击败了奥多阿塞尔,逼入意大利.
te: Theodoric, king of the Ostrogoths, defeats Odoacer at the Battle of Isonzo, forcing his way into Italy.
dz: 奥斯特罗哥特人之王西奥多里克在伊森佐战役中击败了奥多阿塞尔,逼入意大利.
de: Theodoric, king of the Ostrogoths, defeats Odoacer at the Battle of Isonzo, forcing his way into Italy.

t: 大德下之奥斯特罗哥特人第二次击败了奥多阿塞尔的势力.
te: The Ostrogoths under Theoderic the Great defeat the forces of Odoacer for the second time.
